publication.title: High resolution mapping of the tumor microenvironment using integrated single-cell, spatial and in situ analysis
publication.authors: Janesick A, Shelansky R, Gottscho AD, Wagner F, Williams SR, Rouault M, et al.
publication.license_note: Nature Communications is open access under CC BY 4.0. The DATA are deposited separately; see per-source terms below.

data_availability.note: The series-level GSE243280_RAW.tar is 31.78 GB and the Xenium outs.zip is 9.18 GB. Neither is downloaded in full: per-sample files are fetched individually, and a single member is pulled from the Xenium archive using HTTP range requests (scripts/zip_member.py).

sources.description: Xenium Rep 1 cell table (centroids, counts, areas) - one member extracted from a 9.18 GB archive
Published supervised cell-type annotations used for Figures 1-5
Visium CytAssist filtered feature-barcode matrix (raw UMI counts)
Visium spatial bundle: tissue_positions.csv, scalefactors, spatial_enrichment.csv

transformations.xenium: Join cells.csv (centroids) to the supervised annotation on cell_id == Barcode. No value altered; coordinates passed through in micrometres.
transformations.visium: Each spot scaled to the median total UMI count across spots (median = 13532), then log2(1 + x) for display. The normalisation was RECOVERED and verified against the deposited per-gene 'Median Normalized Average Counts' for all 18,056 genes (worst relative difference 8.6e-13).

licensing_posture: No 10x Genomics software or restricted companion code is copied or vendored. Every operation is implemented independently from the deposited data.
